parameters.name: ContainerGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the ECI instances. The value is the same as the container group ID. Specify the IDs in a JSON array. You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description: The type of monitoring data. Only summary is supported. If you set this parameter to summary, Records are returned.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.
